Silent Mourning Demo v1.6 

OPTIMASATION UPDATE

notes.title: Silent Mourning Demo Patch v1.5
notes.notes:
[u][b]Silent Mourning Patch v1.5[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Resolution Setting now save between sessions
[*] Doors are now WAY MORE responsive
[*] Car has re-entered this mortal realm on day 2
[*] No more stealing the fishing rod
[*] Settings page should be easier to see
[*] UI Rework, hopefully a bit more thematic now
[*] Can toggle visibility of todo list
[*] Phone can no longer be used to phase through walls, sorry speed runners
[*] Can now control phone light separately to movement in night with Left Click
[*] Changed a few controls, check the tutorials prompts :)
[*] Removed Herobrine
[/list]

notes.title: Silent Mourning Demo Patch v1.4
notes.notes:
[b]Silent Mourning Demo Patch v1.4[/b]

-The fire is no longer the safest place in the house, although it is still rather cosy

- Fixed misc textures

- The car no longer drives away during the night 

- Added arrows to the main menu to help indicate there is stuff there

- Added save system. will automatically save at the end of each day/night

- Keep an ear out for some new noises in the day time

- Can now interact with mysterious notes to bring them up on screen for easier reading

- Removed Herobrine

notes.title: Silent Mourning Demo Patch v1.3
notes.notes:
-player went on diet, should be easier to get through doors now.
-hitboxes on cabin should be a bit better
-FOV Slider in Gameplay settings
-fixed a bug with the wolf creature
-added voicelines that hint toward how to beat creatures.
-added safety net on night 1 so it takes multiple failures. now night one should feel more tutorial like.
-removed Herobrine

notes.title: Demo Patch v1.1
notes.notes:
Silent Mourning Demo/EA v1.1 Patch Notes

- added skip button for cutscenes and day 1 (keep in mind your chores will not be done)
- fixed hitboxes on many objects, You should no longer be eternally trapped 
- fixed fishing in day 2, fill your boots
- fixed day time monster getting too cocky and not disappearing
- made day 2 monsters less aggressive
- updated tutorial in night with some important info
- made night 1 & 2 easier (sorry for all the jump scares)
- fixed plot guiding voice lines in day 1
- added prompt for Trail Cam Footage
- took the horned one to the chiropractor, he should no longer belong in Notre Dame
- added more freedom of movement for the flashlight
- phone no longer works when out of battery at night, still lasts all day cause...solar panels or something
- your phone now drains battery passively too, might need to buy a new one tbh
- fog is slightly less dense now, this is Silent Mourning not Silent Hill
- made aiming the axe slightly more forgiving 
- the birds are now also scared of the monsters
- attacking creatures should be more obvious
- no longer wearing only socks on day 2, so your footsteps make sound now
- fixed some death animations
- WD40 has worn off the doors on day 2, they now make noise 
- some textures fixed on cabin
- fixed quantum tunneling of items in night 2
- removed Herobrine
